title: Extract an interface from the members used (scratch + compile gate)
summary: Declares an interface from the members of a class the project uses and adds it to the class; --apply through a scratch build and the compile gate
intro: Read this when a class needs an interface and you want it to hold what its callers actually use, not every public method. The default prints the plan, the very text it would write; --apply builds a scratch copy with the change first, then builds the project before and after and rolls back on any error. No consumer is retyped, so no lifetime changes.
